name: iter7-report
title: Auditron Build Gate — Teaser and Navigation Remediation
summary: The custom Teaser renderer and explicit active-navigation change are present on disk, but Maven build/deploy failed before packaging at BND manifest generation. No Author revalidation of these changes is valid.

matrix.detail: Custom Teaser HTL and header active Boolean are on disk
bnd-maven-plugin Calc manifest failure at filters/package-info.class

findings.title: BND manifest calculation fails before package/deploy
findings.issue: The build cannot produce a validated core bundle after the latest remediation.
findings.evidence: mvn clean install -PautoInstallSinglePackage exit=1; bnd-maven-plugin:bnd-process reports ‘Calc manifest failed’ at core/target/classes/com/adlccrowdstrike/aem/core/filters/package-info.class.
findings.cause: BND/package metadata must be diagnosed from the core bundle configuration and the affected package-info source; the Maven tail does not provide a narrower root cause.
findings.recommendation: Blockwright should inspect the affected package-info and BND export/import configuration, fix the manifest calculation, then request a new Auditron build/deploy before claiming Teaser or navigation remediation is deployed.

blocks.p: The new custom `teaser.html` directly renders title, jcr:description and fileReference, and header item2 has active=true. Their runtime behavior is not reported as pass because the build failed before deployment.
